observedCombatPanel.provenance: accepted O18 run after required live-panel check

interpretation: At the controlled one-defended-hit O18 boundary, all 20 strength-loss intervals fall in the predeclared die-1 or die-2 bands, with 8/12 outcomes and no zero or out-of-support interval. K=12 lies inside the exact two-sided 1% Binomial(20,0.5) acceptance region 4..16. This narrowly validates the ordinary unarmored strength die as UniformInteger(1,2).
